import { renderMarkdownToHtml } from './markdown';
import type { Page } from './types';

export interface BuildOptions {

const MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS = /\.(md|markdown)$/;

export function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'/g, ''');
}

function pageTitle(data: Record<string, unknown>, slug: string): string {
  const title = data.title;
  return typeof title === 'string' && title.trim().length > 0 ? title : slug;
}

function pageDate(data: Record<string, unknown>): string | undefined {
  const date = data.date;
  return typeof date === 'string' && date.length > 0 ? date : undefined;
}

function pageTags(data: Record<string, unknown>): string[] | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(data.tags)) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const tags = data.tags.map(String).filter((tag) => tag.trim().length > 0);
  return tags.length > 0 ? tags : undefined;
}

function readPages(contentDir: string): Page[] {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(contentDir);
  const files = entries.filter((entry) => MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS.test(entry)).sort();
  const pages: Page[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(contentDir, file), 'utf8');
    const slug = file.replace(MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS, '');
    const { data, content, html } = renderMarkdownToHtml(raw);
    pages.push({
      slug,
      title: pageTitle(data, slug),
      date: pageDate(data),
      tags: pageTags(data),
      contentHtml: html,
      content,
    });
  }
  return pages;
}

1: """
2: Codebase seed — Minimal Express Todo API (tier 1, good seams)
3: 
4: A single-file Express app with clean structure: models, routes, error handling.
5: Designed as a baseline for multi-session TypeScript stories.
6: """
7: 
8: import express, { Request, Response } from 'express';
9: import sqlite3 from 'better-sqlite3';
10: 
11: const app = express();
12: app.use(express.json());
13: 
14: const DATABASE = process.env.DATABASE || 'todos.db';
15: const db = sqlite3(DATABASE);
16: 
17: db.exec(`
18:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
19:     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
20:     title TEXT NOT NULL,
21:     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
22:     created_at TEXT NOT NULL
23:   )
24: `);
25: 
26: // ── Models ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
27: 
28: interface Task {
29:   id: number;
30:   title: string;
31:   status: string;
32:   created_at: string;

const MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS = /\.(md|markdown)$/;

  return value

    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')

  const title = data.title;

function pageDate(data: Record<string, unknown>): string | undefined {
  const date = data.date;

}

function pageTags(data: Record<string, unknown>): string[] | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(data.tags)) {

  }
  const tags = data.tags.map(String).filter((tag) => tag.trim().length > 0);
  return tags.length > 0 ? tags : undefined;
}

function readPages(contentDir: string): Page[] {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(contentDir);
  const files = entries.filter((entry) => MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS.test(entry)).sort();
  const pages: Page[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {

      title: pageTitle(data, slug),
      date: pageDate(data),
      tags: pageTags(data),
      contentHtml: html,
      content,
    });
  }
  return pages;
}

36:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
37:   const stmt = db.prepare(
38:     "INSERT INTO tasks (title, status, created_at) VALUES (?, 'pending', ?)"
39:   );
40:   const result = stmt.run(title, now);
41:   return { id: result.lastInsertRowid as number, title, status: 'pending', created_at: now };
42: }
43: 
44: function getTasks(): Task[] {
45:   return db.prepare("SELECT * FROM tasks ORDER BY created_at DESC").all() as Task[];
46: }

export interface BuildOptions {

const MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS = /\.(md|markdown)$/;

export function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'/g, ''');
}

function pageTitle(data: Record<string, unknown>, slug: string): string {
  const title = data.title;
  return typeof title === 'string' && title.trim().length > 0 ? title : slug;
}

function pageDate(data: Record<string, unknown>): string | undefined {
  const date = data.date;
  return typeof date === 'string' && date.length > 0 ? date : undefined;
}

function pageTags(data: Record<string, unknown>): string[] | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(data.tags)) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const tags = data.tags.map(String).filter((tag) => tag.trim().length > 0);
  return tags.length > 0 ? tags : undefined;
}

function readPages(contentDir: string): Page[] {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(contentDir);
  const files = entries.filter((entry) => MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS.test(entry)).sort();
  const pages: Page[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(contentDir, file), 'utf8');
    const slug = file.replace(MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS, '');
    const { data, content, html } = renderMarkdownToHtml(raw);
    pages.push({
      slug,
      title: pageTitle(data, slug),
      date: pageDate(data),
      tags: pageTags(data),
      contentHtml: html,
      content,
    });
  }
  return pages;
}

import path from 'path';
import { renderMarkdownToHtml } from './markdown';
import type { Page } from './types';

export interface BuildOptions {
  contentDir: string;
  outputDir: string;
}

const MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS = /\.(md|markdown)$/;

export function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'/g, ''');
}

function pageTitle(data: Record<string, unknown>, slug: string): string {
  const title = data.title;
  return typeof title === 'string' && title.trim().length > 0 ? title : slug;
}

function pageDate(data: Record<string, unknown>): string | undefined {
  const date = data.date;
  return typeof date === 'string' && date.length > 0 ? date : undefined;
}

function pageTags(data: Record<string, unknown>): string[] | undefined {
  if (!Array.isArray(data.tags)) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const tags = data.tags.map(String).filter((tag) => tag.trim().length > 0);
  return tags.length > 0 ? tags : undefined;
}

function readPages(contentDir: string): Page[] {
  const entries = fs.readdirSync(contentDir);
  const files = entries.filter((entry) => MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS.test(entry)).sort();
  const pages: Page[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    const raw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(contentDir, file), 'utf8');
    const slug = file.replace(MARKDOWN_EXTENSIONS, '');
    const { data, content, html } = renderMarkdownToHtml(raw);
    pages.push({
      slug,
      title: pageTitle(data, slug),
      date: pageDate(data),
      tags: pageTags(data),
      contentHtml: html,
      content,
    });
  }
  return pages;
}

part.text:
Added Handlebars template engine and layout support to the SSG.

- `src/templates.ts` — new `TemplateEngine` that loads `templates/*.hbs` (page templates), `templates/layouts/*.hbs` (layouts with `{{{body}}}`), and `templates/partials/*.hbs` (header/footer/nav includes). Pages pick a template/layout via frontmatter; `default` is used when none is set. Missing explicit templates/layouts throw clear errors; missing default templates fall back to built-in rendering.
- `src/generator.ts` — `readPages` now carries frontmatter (`data`, `template`, `layout`); `buildSite` uses the engine when a `./templates` dir (or explicit `templateDir`) exists, otherwise keeps the original built-in rendering. Index rendering also uses an `index.hbs` template when present.
- `src/types.ts` — `Page` gained optional `template`, `layout`, `data`; added `PageContext`.
- `src/escape.ts` — shared `escapeHtml` (re-exported from generator for compat).
- `src/cli.ts` — new `--templates <dir>` option.
- `package.json` — added `handlebars` dependency.
- `__tests__/templates.test.ts` — 16 new tests covering directory structure, default/per-page templates, layouts, partials, frontmatter data + escaping, index templating, error cases, and the CLI binary.

Verified end-to-end via `npx ssg build` against a sample `templates/` tree; all 32 existing tests still pass.
